setlist-fpx 0.9.3

- Initial release of shell toolkit for setlist.fm using curl and fpx—no MCP required.
- Supports searching/reading setlists, artists, venues, cities, and users via the public REST API with an x-api-key.
- Enables toggling “I was there” attendance on setlist.fm using an fpx-extracted session cookie, replicating browser interaction.
- Clear separation of API-key reads (no login needed) and cookie-authenticated writes (attendance toggle).
- Includes detailed usage, setup instructions, and compliance notes in SKILL.md.
